subject: general
question: If A is 80% more than B and B is 20% less than C, then what will be the value of A : B : C?
solution:
Given:

A is 80% more than B and B is 20% less than C

Concept used:

Application of Percentage 

Calculation:

Let be C be 100Q

Hence,

B = 100Q - 100Q × 20% = 80Q

A = 80Q + 80% × 80Q = 144Q

Thus,

A : B : C

⇒ 144Q : 80Q : 100Q

⇒ 36 : 20 : 25

**∴ The value of A : B : C is 36 : 20 : 25.**
